spiffe_x509_svid_leaf_constraints.key_usage: digitalSignature MUST be set; keyCertSign & crlSign MUST NOT be set
spiffe_x509_svid_leaf_constraints.extended_key_usage: clientAuth and/or serverAuth MUST be set if extension present
spiffe_x509_svid_leaf_constraints.subject_alternative_name: URI SAN MUST contain valid spiffe:// ID
spiffe_x509_svid_leaf_constraints.trust_domain_confinement: Trust domain extracted from SVID MUST match expected trust domain
spiffe_x509_svid_leaf_constraints.validity_window: now MUST be between not_before and not_after
